narrative_function_descriptions.state_change: A tracked state changes: agency, identity, life or death, belonging, or ownership of a key item.
narrative_function_descriptions.reveal: A disclosure changes how earlier and later material is understood; reveal order matters.
narrative_function_descriptions.objective: An objective or motivation is established, changed, or abandoned.
narrative_function_descriptions.conflict: Opposition, conflict, or stakes are raised.
narrative_function_descriptions.resolution: A conflict, question, or tension is resolved.
narrative_function_descriptions.causal_link: Explains why something happened or what followed from it; may itself be the node's main function.
narrative_function_descriptions.movement: A spatial or temporal transition, movement, or scene change.
narrative_function_descriptions.world_lore: In-world setting, history, or world-mechanism explanation.
narrative_function_descriptions.explanation: An in-world explanation of why or how a mechanism, event, or state works.
narrative_function_descriptions.commentary: Authorial or critical explanation, interpretation, critique, comparison, or production context.

setup_payoff: setup: a node that introduces a question, condition, tension, or foreshadowing later answered, fulfilled, or reversed.
payoff: a node that answers, fulfills, or reverses the setup.
Do not use for ordinary temporal adjacency or a loose echo.
causal_link: cause: a node that explains, triggers, or enables the effect.
effect: a node that is explained, triggered, or caused.
Do not use for sequence alone.
entity_thread: a/b: two nodes share the same person, place, object, or concept, and that shared relation helps the selector understand the main line.
Do not connect nodes mechanically because of a surface-name match.
duplicates: a/b: two nodes express the same event or claim, warning the selector against retelling it.
complements: a/b: two non-duplicate nodes complete the same understanding when combined.
contrasts: a/b: two nodes contrast in state, position, information, or outcome.
